q: Schumacher's quantum source coding theorem says an i.i.d. quantum source ρ⊗n can be compressed to:
opts: H(ρ) qubits/symbol where H is Shannon entropy of the eigenvalues
S(ρ) qubits/symbol where S(ρ)=-Tr[ρ log ρ] is von Neumann entropy
exp: Schumacher (1995): the optimal quantum compression rate is S(ρ) qubits/symbol — the von Neumann entropy. This is the quantum analogue of Shannon's source coding theorem, with von Neumann entropy replacing Shannon entropy.
